summary: Eviction petition; res judicata; dismissal for failure to adduce evidence treated as decision on merits; Order 17 Rule 3 CPC; subsequent eviction petition barred; High Court rejection of plaint upheld; preclusive effect of prior adjudication; Additional Rent Controller's order overturned by High Court; plea of res judicata sustained.
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Civil Procedure Order 7 Rule 11
Code of Civil Procedure Order 17 Rule 3
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment upholding res judicata and rejecting plaint affirmed.
